description: Make an Instagram ad from one product photo. Choose a 9:16 Reel or square still, see the credit cost first, and download without a watermark.
h1: AI Instagram Ads from One Product Photo
lead: Turn one product photo into an Instagram ad. Choose a tall clip or a square still, see the credit cost first, and download a file with no watermark.
card: Instagram ads from one product photo, as a tall clip or a square still.

faq.q: What can I make here for Instagram?
faq.a: A tall clip for full-screen placements, or a square still for the grid, both from one product photo. You pick the shape. The credit cost shows first.

faq.q: How do I make an Instagram ad from one photo?
faq.a: Upload a clear picture, describe one moment, choose the tall clip or the square still, and download the file when it is ready.

faq.q: Do you have ready-made Reel layouts?
faq.a: No. Describe one moment, choose a tall clip, and download it. No Reel layout is applied for you.
A still costs 24 credits. A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the price shows before you start. If a job fails, those credits return on their own.
No. Add the caption, sticker and soundtrack after download. The file has no watermark and is yours to use in organic posts and paid ads.

faq.q: Can I run the same file in a paid campaign?
faq.a: Yes. Download it, then upload it yourself. Follow the current ad-review prompts for the market where the ad will run.

faq.q: Do I need a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. If a person appears, that presenter is generated. It is not a real customer and not a creator you booked.

faq.q: Which frame should I check before export?
faq.a: Compare your placement with [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform), then preview the file so interface controls do not cover the item.
